description:
Changing Healthcare For Good

At Angle Health, we believe the healthcare system should be accessible, transparent, and easy to navigate. As an AI-native, integrated healthcare company, we are replacing legacy systems with modern infrastructure to deliver members and patients the care they need when they need it. If you want to build the future of healthcare, we'd love for you to join us.

The Role

We're seeking our first Head of Provider Partnerships, reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer. As the senior leader in charge of our provider ecosystem, you will shape how Angle Health contracts, partners with, and leverages provider relationships to deliver member value, access, and financial margin.

This is a commercial leadership role, with the mandate to:

  • Own our approach to provider networks, health system contracts, and direct provider engagement

  • Oversee relationships with modality partners and the development of bundled offerings

  • Turn provider and partner relationships into a competitive advantage for Angle Health: driving access, redundancy, and operating margin

You will have significant influence over strategic direction, collaborating cross-functionally to build a best-in-class provider network and partnership platform.

What You Will Own

  • Leased network management: Own Angle's relationships with national and regional leased PPO and high-performance networks. Manage access, performance, renewals, escalations, and build redundancy so no single network carries the book.

  • Direct contracting: Source, negotiate, and launch direct agreements with health systems, facilities, and specialty providers in priority markets, layered alongside our leased networks.

  • Provider relations: Serve as the senior point of contact for health systems, facilities, and revenue cycle management firms. Build processes and workflows to resolve disputes through direct communication, starting with our highest-volume health systems.

  • Modality partner contracting, sourcing, and management: Source, contract, and manage the care-modality partners Angle steers members to, such as imaging, infusion, oncology, and labs. Prioritize modalities by claims need, negotiate terms without minimum-volume commitments, and manage each partner's performance, steered volume, and savings once live.

  • Dynamic bundling: When Angle identifies a steerage opportunity, build a bundle from provider case rates, price it with a margin tied to member and plan savings, and get it live. You will have product and data tooling; you own the commercial build.

You will also work closely with product, claims operations, and underwriting so network economics feed directly into pricing and plan design.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • Redundancy: Every priority market has credible backup network access in place.

  • Modality partners: Priority modalities contracted and live, with steered volume and savings reported per partner.

  • Bundles: First bundles live and receiving steered members, with savings and margin tracked per bundle.

  • Provider experience: Named senior contacts at each top-volume health system, and fewer, faster-resolved provider escalations.

What You Bring

Required

  • 8+ years in provider network management, contracting, or provider relations at a health plan, network, TPA, health system, or provider-side organization.

  • Track record negotiating facility and professional agreements, including case rates, bundled rates, and Medicare-based pricing.

  • Working relationships with health system and facility leaders and revenue cycle management firms.

  • Comfort reading claims, repricing, and rate data to make a commercial case.

  • An operator's bias: you build the process yourself, then hand it off.

Preferred

  • Experience with bundled payments, centers of excellence, or direct-to-employer contracting.

  • Experience sourcing and contracting specialty care vendors and point solutions (imaging, infusion, oncology, labs).

  • Familiarity with leased networks, network aggregators, or reference-based pricing.

  • A TPA, self-funded, or venture-backed background is welcome but not required.

If you’re ready to lead innovation and growth at the intersection of provider relationships and scalable healthcare delivery, we’d love to meet you!

About Us
Backed by a team of world class investors, we are a healthcare startup on a mission to make our health system more effective, accessible, and affordable to everyone. From running large hospitals and health plans to serving on federal healthcare advisory boards to solving the world's hardest problems at Palantir, our team has done it all. As part of this core group at Angle Health, you will have the right balance of support and autonomy to grow both personally and professionally and the opportunity to own large parts of the business and scale with the company. 

Angle Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Angle Health is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. 

⚠️ A Note on Recruiting Outreach
We’ve been made aware of individuals falsely claiming to represent Angle Health using lookalike email addresses (like @anglehealthcareers.com). Please note that all legitimate emails from our team come from @anglehealth.com. We will never ask for sensitive information or conduct interviews via messaging apps.
